product.name: BambinoCare Silicone Feeding Set
product.description: The BambinoCare Silicone Feeding Set is a versatile, BPA‑free solution designed for parents who value safety and convenience. The set includes a 200‑ml feeding cup, a detachable silicone spout, and a stainless‑steel spoon, all crafted from medical‑grade silicone that remains flexible at low temperatures and resists staining. The pastel‑blue finish adds a cheerful touch to mealtime, while the integrated silicone sleeve keeps the cup cool during hot or cold feeds. Easy‑to‑assemble parts snap together securely, and the entire set is dishwasher safe for quick cleanup. Ideal for infants and toddlers, the feeding set supports gradual transition from bottle to cup, encouraging self‑feeding and independence.
